top5.name: A1+B1 combo: fee-truncated target + fee-clipped weight
top5.target_or_data_change: y = sign(delta) * max(0, |delta| - 2*fee); w = max(0, |delta| - 2*fee). Replaces both target geometry and sample weight with PnL-aware ReLU.
top5.rationale: Directly aligns target with platform PnL fee structure. Different from T87 SPO+ (loss surrogate, target=delta) and T92 magnitude weights (smooth decay). ReLU hard truncation is the missing variant. Cheapest high-upside change.

top5.name: G3: Heteroscedastic regression + Sharpe gate
top5.target_or_data_change: Train M1 fit mu=delta; train M2 fit log(residual^2). At inference: score = mu/sigma; threshold on Sharpe-like score. Provides per-sample uncertainty.
top5.rationale: T86 dual-gate (q=0.3,q=0.7) gave +1.94 with crude uncertainty proxy. Heteroscedastic NLL is principled extension. Addresses 49.6% missed-due-to-fear samples by exposing high-Sharpe samples that pure point-estimate threshold misses.

top5.name: C1: Masked LOB SSL pre-training (MAE-style)
top5.target_or_data_change: Pre-train Transformer/CNN encoder on 2.4M ticks with 30% masked feature reconstruction. Extract 256-d embedding per 100-tick window. Concat with 359-d hand features -> 615-d. Retrain LightGBM.
top5.rationale: Project has NEVER attempted SSL. 384k held-out sym ticks + 480k val/test ticks are unlabeled but feature-distribution-relevant. SSL is fully red-line compliant (no labels = no leak). Should reduce NN/LGB cross-corr (0.77) by injecting orthogonal inductive bias.

top5.name: A3: Sign-magnitude decoupled heads
top5.target_or_data_change: M_dir: 2-class classifier on sign(delta), trained ONLY on |delta|>2*fee subset (~40% data). M_mag: regression on |delta|, all data. Inference: score = (P(+) - P(-)) * mag. Multiplicative fusion.
top5.rationale: Direction prediction is contaminated by random-sign noise band; magnitude prediction needs all samples for vol regime. Decoupling lets each task use its inductive strength. Distinct from T72 binary cascade (which is sequential).

top5.name: A4 hybrid: best-PnL-reachability auxiliary regression
top5.target_or_data_change: Add aux head: y_aux = max over h in {5,10,20,40,60} of sign(delta_h)*max(0,|delta_h|-2*fee). Used as confidence filter at inference: only fire trade if main pred and aux pred agree.
top5.rationale: Directly aligned with platform max-over-horizons scoring. Distinct from T77 multihorizon vote (which combined predictions, not targets). Aux target as confidence filter is a new use-pattern.

discussion_only.name: D3: Multi-target joint regression (delta_60, sigma_60, max_drawdown, time_to_max, OFI_60)
discussion_only.note: XGBoost multi-output. Forces backbone to learn richer LOB representation via auxiliary heads.

discussion_only.name: H1: Curriculum learning by signal quality (3-stage warm-start)
discussion_only.note: Stage 1: |delta|>4*fee (~25%). Stage 2: |delta|>2*fee (~40%). Stage 3: all + fee-clip weight. Uses LightGBM init_model. Different from T92 (static) - this is sequential.

discussion_only.name: E1: Velocity / acceleration auxiliary targets
discussion_only.note: v(t) = delta(h=10) - delta(h=5); a(t) = v(t+5) - v(t). Joint regression of (delta_60, v, a). Aux for backbone to learn drift dynamics.

key_insights: T92 failed because all 8 variants used SMOOTH magnitude weights (linear/sqrt/log/clipped). The missing experiment is ReLU hard-truncation at fee threshold (B1). Smooth and ReLU are different families.
The fee structure is in inference threshold, not in target/loss. Any change that pushes fee into target geometry (A1) or loss landscape (B1, T87 SPO+) is structurally novel and orthogonal.
Project never attempted SSL despite 384k+ unlabeled-data-eligible ticks. SSL is red-line compliant since it doesn't use labels.
T86 quantile dual-gate (+1.94) proved per-sample uncertainty is exploitable. G3 heteroscedastic is the principled scaling.
iter_014 model output is 1-d (mu); upgrading to (mu, sigma) gives a Sharpe-style decision rule that addresses recall bottleneck (49.6% missed).
stacking_combinations_to_test: A1 + B1: target + weight both fee-clipped (clean noise rejection)
A1 + G3: fee-truncated target + heteroscedastic sigma (combine PnL-aware target with uncertainty)
C1 + A1: SSL embedding + fee-truncated target (orthogonal, max value)
notes: Reasoning grounded in first-principles math (PnL formula decomposition, gradient analysis on truncated targets, two-stage NLL derivation). Each idea explicitly differentiated from existing T1-T98 attempts. All ideas red-line audited.
